Quote: The only way out of the labyrinth of suffering is to forgive.
Author: John Green

Quote: Real courage is when you know you're licked before you begin, but you begin anyway and see it through no matter what.
Author: Harper Lee

Quote: It is our choices, Harry, that show what we truly are, far more than our abilities.
Author: J.K. Rowling
Book: Harry Potter and the Chamber of Secrets

Quote: I am not afraid of storms, for I am learning how to sail my ship.
Author: Louisa May Alcott

Quote: Whatever our souls are made of, his and mine are the same.
Author: Emily Brontë

Quote: The mystery of life isn't a problem to solve, but a reality to experience.
Author: Frank Herbert

Quote: In spite of everything, I still believe that people are really good at heart.
Author: Anne Frank
Book: The Diary of a Young Girl

Quote: It is a far, far better thing that I do, than I have ever done; it is a far, far better rest that I go to than I have ever known.
Author: Charles Dickens

Quote: So we beat on, boats against the current, borne back ceaselessly into the past.
Author: F. Scott Fitzgerald

Quote: You pierce my soul. I am half agony, half hope.
Author: Jane Austen
